46) If any topic leads to heated discussion in a classroom, then what is expected from a teacher ?

54) Which of the following can be treated as secondary sources for a social science class ?

55) Match the following and choose the appropriate option.
(a) Analytical Rubric	(i) Containing performance descriptors and learning outcomes.
(b) Checklist	(ii) Single scale but detailed performance descriptors
(c) Holistic Rubric	(iii) Binary scale but detailed performance descriptors
Options :
(1) (a)-(i), (b)-(ii), (c)-(iii)
(2) (a)-(ii), (b)-(i), (c)-(iii)
(3) (a)-(i), (b)-(iii), (c)-(ii)
(4) (a)-(ii), (b)-(iii), (c)-(i)

56) Which of the following questions assess the application aspect of cognitive process ?
(A) What were the reasons for the revolt of 1857 ?
(B) State one difference between economic activities and non-economic activities. Give suitable examples.
(C) What are direct taxes ? Give examples.
(D) Many nations in South Asia are not federal systems of governance. Explain.
Options :
(1) (A), (B) and (C)
(2) (B), (C) and (D)
(3) (A), (C) and (D)
(4) (A), (B) and (D)

57) Which of the following questions assess only the factual knowledge of learners ?
(A) Define climate and season. What are main seasons in India ?
(B) Give three differences between the way villages are managed today and in time of mahajanapadas.
(C) How presence of flora and fauna affects the formation of humus ?
(D) What do you understand by the people as a resource ?
Options :
(1) Only (A)
(2) Only (A) and (B)
(3) Only (A), (B) and (C)
(4) Only (B), (C) and (D)

58) Which of the following are required to develop evaluation procedures according to the RTE Act 2009 ?

(B) Connecting from local to global aspects of knowledge
(C) Learning through activities, discovery and exploration
(D) Learning in the child friendly and child-centered manner
Options :
(1) Only (A), (B) and (C)
(2) Only (B), (C) and (D)
(3) Only (A), (C) and (D)
(4) Only (A), (B) and (D)

59) Assessment is done in schools for the following reasons. Choose the appropriate option.
(A) Certifying students of their learning achievement
(B) Understanding the learning difficulties faced by the students
(C) To make teachers accountable to the school
(D) To find out the ways and means to overcome the learning difficulties
Options :
(1) Only (A)
(2) Only (A) and (C)
(3) Only (A), (B) and (D)
(4) Only (C)

60) Which of the following questions assess mainly the social science learning outcome - "Develop the capacity for empathy/appreciation and sensitivity" ?
(A) Describe the ways to restore ground water in your area.
(B) It is becoming very difficult to protect India's heritage sites. Do you agree with this statement ? Justify.
(C) A large section of India's rural children are undernourished. Explain.
(D) What are hindrances in national integration ?
Options :
(1) Only (A), (B) and (C)
(2) Only (B) and (C)
(3) Only (C) and (D)
(4) Only (A), (C) and (D)
